description: 부산광역시_부산버스정보시스템 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 부산광역시. 부산광역시 부산버스정보시스템 API는 시내버스를 이용하는 시민과 개발자를 위해 실시간 교통 정보를 제공하는 서비스로, 정류소·노선·도착 예정 정보를 다양한 조건으로 조회할 수 있는. Coverage: 부산광역시. The portal files it under the publisher 부산광역시. Its tags are 부산, 버스, 대중교통, 실시간정보, 버스정류소. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
